category_title: Failing students who reject observation tasks and provide emotional feedback
scenario_title: Observation worksheet rejection and emotional feedback
minimal_context: A student is observing their partner during a badminton match and is supposed to transcribe point locations onto a detailed observation worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is the detailed observation worksheet. While your partner plays this set, I need you to watch and record the zones where the points are scored.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't see the point of the work required. I'm playing against him next anyway.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best to observe. What are you going to tell him during the break between sets?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'll just tell him 'You played well' or 'You played badly'. I don't need to write anything down.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look at the paper and try to identify the specific zones.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the paper away) No, I'm not filling out the worksheet correctly or identifying the zones. I don't want this.
